description: Read invoices, purchase orders, and contracts from PDF addresses and return fixed fields: numbers, dates, parties, totals, line items, and a totals check, or contract parties, dates, term, renewal, notice days, governing law, and clauses found. Scans go through OCR. Rule based with no AI, so a value with no known label stays null. Pay per event on Apify: 0.01 USD per document, 0.015 USD per scanned page.

date_order.description: How to read a date such as 03/04/2025 when both readings are valid. mdy (default) reads March 4, dmy reads 3 April. Unambiguous dates ignore this.

document_type.description: auto (default) works it out per file. Set invoice, purchase_order, or contract to read every file as that type.

include_text.description: yes: add the document text to the row, up to 200,000 characters. Default no.

line_item_rows.description: yes (default): each line item is also its own free row, which suits CSV and Clay. no: line items stay in the line_items field only.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_documents.description: Files to read in this run, up to 1,000. Default 100.

max_ocr_pages.description: Scanned pages to read per file, up to 100. Default 10. This caps the OCR charge per file.

max_pages.description: Pages to read per file, up to 500. Default 50.

ocr_language.description: Language of scanned pages: eng (default), deu, fra, spa, nld, ita, or por.

pdf_file.description: Optional. One PDF file from your computer, stored in your Apify account.

pdf_urls.description: Web addresses of PDF files, up to 1,000. Each file up to 40 MB. The address must answer without a login. In Clay, put the column in a one item list.

read_scans.description: yes (default): a page with no text layer goes through OCR, charged per page. no: those pages are skipped and the row says so.

name: extract_business_pdf_fields
title: Extract fields from business PDFs
